scope: Generated parser controls for the ODA-defined AC1021 TABLE cell alignment RS field and the bounded BitShort compatibility candidate observed in existing Autodesk AC1021 TABLE sources.

authority.specification: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1 §20.4.96.1, pp. 230-232
authority.field: cell alignment, RS (raw little-endian 16-bit), selected by override mask 0x01
authority.sequence: cell override flag BL, virtual edge RC, selected alignment RS, separate R2007+ unknown BL, CadValue flags/type/payload, unit BL and detached format/value TV strings

implementation.change: The exact AC1021 text-cell mask 0x01 profile prefers valid raw-RS alignment values. Only when raw RS is outside 1..9 does it retain a valid BitShort candidate, and it marks that interpretation semantically incomplete. Other override masks remain incomplete.
implementation.generatedFrame: The existing from-scratch AC1021 one-cell TABLE vector emits alignment value 5 with putRawShort16, then the separate unknown BL, CadValue flags/type/integer payload, unit and detached empty strings. No DWG/DXF fixture file is written.

assertions: from-scratch raw-RS alignment value 5 parses as complete typed alignment and lands at the next CadValue/table sentinel boundary
from-scratch BitShort alignment value 6 is retained only as a semantically incomplete candidate and lands at the same bounded sentinel
the physical fallback path remains distinct from the normative raw-RS path

peerReview.observation: The peer calls ReadBitShort for cell alignment, while ODA specifies raw RS. Its semantic decode is not independent physical-span proof for these cells.
peerReview.disposition: Do not use peer table values to justify changing the libdxfrw alignment decoder or to claim the physical type-48 cursor issue is resolved.

physicalSource.observation: The metric-source first-failure cells are row 8/column 0 at body bit 278726 (TABLE 0x2856e) and row 9/column 0 at bit 312907 (TABLE 0x2a974). A temporary raw-RS probe reads 42049 at each alignment field. The current bounded fallback instead selects a valid BitShort interpretation, parses the CadValue tails, and leaves the TABLE snapshots semantically incomplete.

physicalReadback.result: Both existing AC1021 sources parse all TABLE CadValues under the fallback. TABLE semantic completeness remains false by policy. The reader publishes 4408/4408 metric frames and 3586/3586 imperial frames with zero entity/object parse failures; strict DXF export stops at the unrelated FIELD/FIELDLIST serializer gate and creates no DXF.

remainingAction: Resolve the producer-specific alignment encoding with authoritative schema/native semantics. Keep the fallback partial and strict output/support claims gated.
